description:
ALL-TERRAIN RIDING PERFORMANCE - Rugged, deeply treaded off-road tires provide enhanced traction and stability across pavement, packed dirt, gravel, and grass. The durable construction makes this self-balancing scooter suitable for neighborhood rides and outdoor adventures.

INTELLIGENT SELF-BALANCING CONTROL - Advanced gyroscope technology responds to the rider’s body movements for smooth acceleration, turning, and stopping. The responsive balancing system helps new riders develop confidence while giving experienced riders precise control.

UP TO 10 MPH & 12–15 MILE RANGE - Reach speeds of up to 10 mph and travel approximately 12 to 15 miles per charge under suitable riding conditions. Actual speed and range may vary based on rider weight, terrain, incline, temperature, and riding style.

BRIGHT LED LIGHTING & NON-SLIP FOOT PADS - Integrated green LED wheel and body lights add visibility and a futuristic appearance. Wide textured foot pads provide a secure standing surface for more comfortable and controlled riding.

220 LB CAPACITY & 15° CLIMBING ABILITY - Built to support riders weighing up to 220 pounds and handle inclines of up to 15 degrees under suitable conditions. The modern gray camouflage finish delivers a bold look that stands out on city streets and outdoor paths. Always wear a helmet and appropriate protective equipment while riding.
